translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Youna la gibuluwa deli Yaubada la nokapisi
Youna nanola imwau sainela paila baisa e igibuluwa.

E inigada baisa Guyau ikaibiga, kawala, “Guyau, ka. Igau gala basilavi ulo valu, bogwa lakaibiga kidamwa bukuvagi makawala. Baisa uula avigikoni mwada basakaula bala mapilana Sipeini. Paila anikolaim yoku Yaubada toyebwaili deli goli tonokapisi, m gibuluwa iyobali, toninabwaila yoku, e tuta tuta kukivilivau nanom e gala kumipuki tomitugaga.
Mapaila Guyau lagaila wala kukwau ulo momova. Ibodaigu wala bakaliga. Gala magigu bamova.”
E Guyau ivitakauloki Youna, kawala, “Ki, avaka dimlela m gibuluwa?”
E mapaila Youna isilavi valu, ila opilibomatu, e baisa isili. E matauna ivagi sitana kaikonigula e isuvi isili okaikonigula. Itulotula paila bigisi avaka mwada biviloubusi baisa mina Niniba.
E oluvi Guyau Yaubada ivali kaitala kai isusina iyokuluvi Youna, e ivigaki kala katumkovila kala kaikonigula, mwada Youna kala lumkola bibwaina. E paila makaina kai Youna saina iyomwasali nanola.
Mitaga eiyam ikikivisiga, Yaubada ikaraiwogi natana kakavaku isoma makaina kai. E makaina ikalayagi imata.

E oluvi kalasia iyuwoula, Yaubada iwitali yagila bomatu biuu saina yuviyavi, deli kalasia yuviyavila. E Youna ilumkoli ikalilavi dabala, mapaila matauna idoki wala bikaliga. E matauna ikaibiga, “Ibodaigu wala bakaliga. Gala magigu bamova.”
E mitaga Yaubada iluki matauna, kawala, “Avaka uula lokugibuluwa paila makaina kai ke?” E Youna ivitakaula kawala, “Isim uula ulo gibuluwa, kainaga gibuluwa wala bikimataigu!”
E Guyau ikaibiga baisa matauna, kawala, “Kai makaina kwaitala bogi isusina, kwaiyuwelaga bogi imata. E yoku gala bukuvagi avaka, kaina bukuvasusuni, mitaga lokunokapisi makaina.
Mitaga yeigu ammakawagu? Ki, mwada nanom gala ibodi banokapisi mina Niniba? Paila mapilana valu saina vilouveka, e isisuaisi gugwadi tobubwaila ikalisau 120,000 kasi bawa, deli goli mauna bidubadu.”
